name: MAJI de Botsuraku 5 Byou Mae
source:
As the daughter of one of Japan's most prestigious families, Reina Katsuragi always comes out on top.
In her view, that's the only acceptable way for her to live. It's the natural state of things.

There's a girl, however, who's really been grating on her later. That girl was Akira Kuse. Despite being poor, Akira's grades were almost as good as Reina's.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ228341.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
作为日本最显赫家族之一的女儿，葛城玲奈总是胜人一筹。
在她看来，这才是唯一可以接受的生活方式，是理所当然的状态。

然而，最近有个女孩一直让她格外恼火。
那个人是久世明。尽管家境贫寒，明的成绩几乎和玲奈一样好。

（来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ228341.html/]DLsite English[/url]）
